note: Chapter 1 is keyed from "Verona's corner" (the kick) through "controls it" (the first touch), "and off he goes", "Past one", "past another", "and another" to "goal": keep the pauses at '...' so the run plays near real time. Chapter 2 pans fast alongside him on "and runs".

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: San Siro, 1996. Verona's corner flies too long. George Weah controls it in his own box, and off he goes! Past one... past another... and another... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Every Milan player was back for the corner. Weah sees open grass ahead, and runs faster than anyone can chase.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Ninety metres later, he stays calm and fires it low past the keeper, into the corner!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: after you defend a corner, look up. Space ahead? Break fast. A quick counter-attack can go all the way!
